index.title: Extract and Sort Art Prompts from Multiple Chats
index.prompt_excerpt: You are 13,425 art prompts, extracted and sorted. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Extract and Sort Art Prompts from Multiple Chats. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result
index.what_happened_excerpt: A Grok Bot was used to extract and sort 13,425 art prompts from 557 chats across multiple projects. The bot worked in small blocks and completed the job in around 30 hours. This job is an example of the public pattern.
